author: Strmr
body:
Faroe TE by Stormer_



Hello! I am proud to present this map to you! 

It is a Tournament Tiebreaker Build for a 10 vs 10. The goal is to break the orb of the enemy team in maximum 10 minutes. The obsidian parts contain a spawner, both will spawn a Diamond pickaxe to break the monument. (you don't have a in your spawn-kit) The small island next to the obsidian spawn TNT, 5 TNT every 15 seconds to aid the breaking of the monument. 

Spawnkit:


Album
Download [v1.0] (YML excluded)
 
Feedback is greatly appreciated!

replies.author: Strmr
replies.body:
I made the map this way to move the focus from TNT to a more PVP based map, I did this because there are not a lot of TNT maps on Avicus, the team that knows how to chaos-cannon will dominate and since there are not a lot of people familiar with cannoning, left alone chaos cannoning, that is why I made TNT so rare and will only aid in the breaking of the monument instead of making a long range Chaos. 

Also, if you try I am sure you can come up with some stratagies that will make cannoning possible

Dude, instead of making a snide comment look at the map shape, cannoning is near impossible, diagonal cannons don't work either, without water you couldn't make a really cool cannon. 

Stormer i understand that and if that's what you want its fine, but i forgot to ask and probably should before i make further comments, could you give us the loadout/inventory for the players? Are blocks destroyable and placeable? Does the TNT light automatically or do you need to set it off, if so what is provided to do so? 

I don't mean to be grilling you but i really think this is a good map and would be great as a tie breaker, i just want to know some more about it before it gets put through.
